pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Lesson
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson focuses on building fluency and confidence in everyday conversations, ideal for intermediate to advanced learners. The session starts with a warm-up, engaging the student in casual dialogue to set the tone. It introduces the topic of small talk, emphasizing its role in social interactions and daily life. Common expressions such as “How’s everything going?” are taught, followed by role-playing activities where the student practices conversations in real-life scenarios, like meeting a new colleague or chatting with a neighbor.

The lesson also includes a fluency exercise where the student speaks continuously on a given topic for a set time, enhancing their ability to think and respond quickly. Feedback is provided throughout the session, focusing on natural corrections in grammar and pronunciation. Finally, the session wraps up with a summary and homework assignment to further practice speaking in everyday contexts.

This approach nurtures real-world communication skills, empowering the student to converse more naturally in English.

pro_course_detail.title: Listening / Spelling
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed to enhance the student’s active listening abilities, which are essential for better understanding spoken English in real-world contexts. The session begins with a brief introduction to the importance of listening, focusing on recognizing key details such as tone, context, and intonation.

The student will listen to short audio clips or conversations on everyday topics (e.g., news reports, interviews, or casual dialogues) and answer comprehension questions. The focus is on identifying main ideas, specific details, and implied meanings.

To develop active engagement, the student practices note-taking while listening to longer passages. Key vocabulary, expressions, and idioms are discussed to improve their understanding of natural speech. The lesson ends with a review of the audio content, error correction, and tips on how to improve listening skills through regular practice, like watching English videos or listening to podcasts.

This approach equips the student with practical strategies to improve comprehension, especially in fast-paced or unfamiliar listening situations.

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar Rules, Vocabulary, Prepositions, Phrasal Verbs
pro_course_detail.description:
Grammar Rules: Focuses on core grammar structures like verb tenses, sentence formation, and subject-verb agreement. Students practice sentence correction and construction to ensure clear understanding and correct usage.

Vocabulary: Expands the student’s word knowledge through topic-based learning, emphasizing word meanings, synonyms, antonyms, and real-life application. Activities like flashcards and conversation help solidify new vocabulary.

Prepositions: Teaches the correct use of prepositions (e.g., “in,” “on,” “at”) through exercises that address common errors. Students practice using prepositional phrases and how they change sentence meanings.

Phrasal Verbs: Introduces phrasal verbs (e.g., “look into,” “get up”) and focuses on their meaning and usage in different contexts. Interactive exercises help students become comfortable using these in conversation.

Each lesson builds practical language skills through exercises and real-life application.
